name: USD/CAD SMA Crossover - Explicit Price Exits
description: SMA crossover strategy on USD/CAD using 20, 50, 200-period SMAs on 1H bars. Long when 20 crosses above 50 or 200, short when crossing below. Position sizing: 300,000 units for 20×50, 600,000 units for 20×200. Exit at +0.01 price movement (100 pips) or -0.005 (50 pips). Example: long at 1.3410 exits at 1.3510 (TP) or 1.3360 (SL).
source:
# USD/CAD SMA Crossover Strategy with Explicit Price Exits
# Long when 20 SMA crosses above 50 or 200 SMA
# Short when 20 SMA crosses below 50 or 200 SMA
# Position sizing: 300k units for 20x50, 600k units for 20x200
# Exit: TP +0.01 (100 pips), SL -0.005 (50 pips)

# Data source - 1H bars
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1H)()
close = src.c

# Calculate SMAs
sma_20 = ma(period=20, type=MAType.sma)(close)
sma_50 = ma(period=50, type=MAType.sma)(close)
sma_200 = ma(period=200, type=MAType.sma)(close)

# Crossover signals for 20x50
long_cross_50 = crossover(sma_20, sma_50)
short_cross_50 = crossunder(sma_20, sma_50)

# Crossover signals for 20x200
long_cross_200 = crossover(sma_20, sma_200)
short_cross_200 = crossunder(sma_20, sma_200)

# Combined entry signals
long_entry = long_cross_50 or long_cross_200
short_entry = short_cross_50 or short_cross_200

# Position sizing based on which crossover triggered
# 600k for 200-period crossover (takes priority), 300k for 50-period crossover
long_size = 600000 if long_cross_200 else (300000 if long_cross_50 else 0)
short_size = 600000 if short_cross_200 else (300000 if short_cross_50 else 0)

# Combined size - use whichever signal is active
position_units = long_size if long_entry else (short_size if short_entry else 0)

# Entry/Exit zones
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=long_entry, short_entry=short_entry)

# Position sizing - fixed units
position_size(type=SizeType.unit)(size=position_units)

# Stop loss: 50 pips = 0.005 absolute price movement
stop_loss(unit=StopUnit.price)(distance=0.005)

# Take profit: 100 pips = 0.01 absolute price movement
take_profit(unit=StopUnit.price)(distance=0.01)

# Visualization - SMAs
timeseries_lines(
    title="SMA Indicators",
    category="Price & Indicators",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Price", color=Color.White),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="SMA 20", color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="SMA 50", color=Color.Orange),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="SMA 200", color=Color.Red)
    ])
)(close, sma_20, sma_50, sma_200)
